meta.name: c-level-agents
meta.description: Founder-mode executive team. 13 cs-* C-suite agents (CFO, CMO, CRO, CPO, COO, CHRO, CISO, GC, CDO, CAIO, CCO, VPE, Chief of Staff) and 21 /cs:* slash commands for forcing-question office hours, multi-role boardroom deliberation, strategic sprint pipeline, and meta routing. Use when the founder needs a virtual executive team, when invoking /cs:* commands, or when orchestrating multi-role decisions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 召集虚拟高管团队,主持多角色战略研讨与决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果作为创始人,需要多位 C-suite 高管的视角来审视战略决策。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a founder needing C-suite perspectives for strategic decisions.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会化身虚拟高管团队：提供 13 个 C 级顾问角色和 21 个 /cs:* 命令，支持单人或多角色决策；每个角色按固定模板输出 Markdown 文件。
howto.when: 当创始人需要虚拟高管团队、使用 /cs:* 命令（如 /cs:onboard、/cs:office-hours、/cs:founder-mode），或需要多角色共同决策时触发。

say.note: 生成公司上下文文件，供后续决策使用。

say.text: 用 /cs:office-hours 评估“该不该招销售副总裁？”
say.note: 触发 YC 式 6 问，引导你理清招聘决策。

say.text: 用 /cs:founder-mode 分析“现金流压力”。
say.note: 自动路由到 CFO 角色，给出对应审查。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a virtual C-suite: 13 executive advisor agents (e.g., CFO, CMO) plus 21 /cs:* slash commands for single-role or multi-role decisions. Each agent asks role-specific questions and outputs a Markdown file using a fixed template.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the founder needs a virtual executive team, invokes /cs:* commands (e.g., /cs:onboard, /cs:office-hours, /cs:founder-mode), or orchestrates multi-role decisions.

say_en.text: Run /cs:onboard first to log company background.
Use /cs:office-hours to assess 'Should we hire a VP of Sales?'

say_en.note: Auto-routes to the right C-role (e.g., CFO).
